method: ecbench price-units-f2m4 --onepass --reps 15 --seed 1: median of the passes per unit per m, one process, one host; hash tables sized as the methods' own (2^(m+1) entries, the guard set 2^20)
unit: time of the native unit / time of one counted F_q multiplication, dimensionless
what: Ratios to one counted F_q multiplication (a dense axpy element on the same field) of every native unit, measured in ONE interleaved pass on one host in one process with a discarded warm-up rep. `row` is what the *_refmm ecbench methods read: every unit's median, with scalar_mulmod, row_op and lp_mulmod each the smaller of the code's kernel and a Montgomery kernel (u64 storage and one limb for a one-word order, u128 and two limbs otherwise); `row_code` and `row_montgomery` are the same table with those three units on one kernel only; `spread` and `mulmod_samples` carry the per-unit spread (src/cryptanalysis/ecbench/f2m4_price.rs, Mulmod::Onepass).
